description: Appointment to the Post of Director General of the Department of National Planning
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Post of Director General of the Department of National Planning has fallen vacant, due to the retirement of Mrs. J.M.S.D.Rathnayake, who served as the Director General of the said Department, from the public service on 2025‑09‑21. Applications had been called from the Special Grade Officers of the Sri Lanka Planning Service to identify a suitable officer to the said post. Accordingly, based on the recommendations of the Interview Board, the proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to appoint Mr. K.T.I Premaratne, Special Grade Officer of the Sri Lanka Planning Service, to the post of Director General of the Department of National Planning, was approved by the Cabinet.
